# QML components in VESC Tool

Every QML file VESC Tool ships, with the members its root object declares. Use this list to decide which components a package may instantiate. Component behaviour is not documented here — read the file at the given path when the member list is not enough.

Signatures use C++ types. In QML: `QString` is a JS string, `QVector<T>` and `QStringList` are JS arrays, `QVariantMap` is a plain JS object, `QVariantList` an array, `QByteArray` an `ArrayBuffer` (read with a `DataView`), and `QVariant` anything.

Generated from vesc_tool `a34c1727` (working tree dirty).

## Examples and desktop loaders (`import "qrc:/res/qml"`)

Reference UIs that VESC Tool ships. The `Examples/` files are working demonstrations of the API surface (gauges, plots, CAN debug, custom app data, profiles) — copy from them. `MainLoader.qml` and `DynamicLoader.qml` are the desktop hosts that instantiate a package's QML; read them to see what a package's root object must satisfy.
